title: Mycoplasma Detection Protocol
author: Andrea Argouarch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8gphtvn
materials: Open the NanoDrop 1000 software and select nucleic acid from the main menu
Select DNA from the dropdown menu

After trypsinization for freezing cells, rinse remaining cells in both flasks with 12 mls 12 mL PBS Trypsin-EDTA (0.05%), phenol red Thermo Fisher Catalog #25300062 DPBS, no calcium, no magnesium Thermo Fisher Catalog #14190250

Extract gDNA with thermocycler program a. Turn on Power button on the back of machine b. Open lid with handle c. Put PCR tubes in small slot and close lid d. Select File, click Enter, select pcr chamber and start program i. 65C 65 °C for 15 mins 00:15:00 ii. 98C 98 °C for 10 mins 00:15:00 iii. 4C 4 °C to hold e. Run time around ~30mins 00:30:00 f. Click enter to exit after run g. Turn off machine and place on ice On ice

steps.title: Prepare for Sample Isolation
steps.instruction: Ensure culture is in at least 3-6 days of subculture after split. Use clean gloves, spray down the bench, and keep all reagents and tubes on ice during isolation and PCR.

steps.title: Isolate Cells and Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Isolate cells once confluent (at least 3-6 days after split).

substeps.instruction: Spin for 5 mins at 1000 rpm at 4 °C
Place in ice bucket on bench or store at -80 °C
Add 40 µL of Quick Extract (Epicentre Catalog #QE09050) to the pellet
Pipette up and down and transfer to PCR tubes (label with line, date, and 'P' for pellet)
Centrifuge PCR tubes for 5 mins at max 13.4 rpm
Transfer supernatant (SN) to new 1.5 mL tubes labeled gDNA, line, and date; keep on ice (a tiny pellet may remain in the PCR tube)

steps.title: Determine gDNA Concentration via NanoDrop
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the gDNA on ice using a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

substeps.instruction: Gather p2 pipette, p2 tips, pen, kimwipes, and ice bucket
Clean the pedestal with a kimwipe
Add 2 µL of nuclease-free water to the center of the pedestal, gently close the lever arm, and click 'OK' to initialize
Clean the pedestal with a kimwipe, add 2 µL of quick extract solution as a blank sample, and click 'Blank'
Clean the pedestal with a kimwipe, add 2 µL of sample, and click 'Measure'
Record the concentration (ng/ul), 260/280 ratio (should be > 1.8), and 260/230 ratio (should be 1-2) on the tube and a table
Clean the pedestal with a kimwipe between samples
Click exit and leave a kimwipe between the pedestal and lever arm when finished

steps.title: Prepare PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare a 20 µL PCR reaction in e-Myco Plasma PCR Tubes (e-Myco PLUS Mycoplasma PCR Detection Kit, Catalog #25234) on ice.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 ng of sample (create a working stock if concentration is too high)
QS to 20 µL with nuclease-free water
Prepare a negative control using 20 µL of water
Prepare a positive control using 1 µL of the provided positive control
Turn on the machine at the back
Tap to mix samples, place them into the thermocycler small tube holes, and close the lid

Set and run the myco program: Initial Denature 94 °C for 1 min; 35 Cycles of (Denature 94 °C for 30 secs, Anneal 58 °C for 20 secs, Extend 72 °C for 1 min); Final Extension 72 °C for 5 mins; Hold at 4 °C
Press enter to run (total run time ~1.5 hours)
After the run, select enter, turn off the machine, and place PCR products on ice

steps.title: Prepare Agarose Gel
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2% agarose gel for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Wet the rubber around the gel chamber to facilitate sliding into the rig
Assemble the rig with rubber on the black edges and place the purple comb in the right slot
Mix 1.2 g of agarose (Catalog #PBSA1705) with 60 mL of 1X TAE in a small beaker with a screw cap
Microwave for 2 mins with a loose cap, swirling every 30 seconds until dissolved
When cool to the touch, add 6 µL of EtBr (1% Solution, Fisher Scientific Catalog #BP130210) per 60 mL of agarose
Swirl to mix, pour into the chamber, and allow to cool in the cold room (4 °C) for 10 mins

steps.title: Prepare Gel Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR products for loading on ice.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 µL of PCR product, 3 µL of nuclease-free water, and 2.6 µL of 6X loading buffer (NEB Catalog #B7021S) per sample

steps.title: Run Gel Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load and run the gel to visualize results.

substeps.instruction: Rotate the set gel chamber so lanes are at the top
Fill with 1X TAE until the top of the white knob and remove the comb slowly
Load 4 µL of 1kb O’gene plus ladder (Thermo Fisher Catalog #SM1333) into the first lane
Load 11 µL of each sample per well
Add the lid (black at top, red at bottom, both on the right side)
Run at 130V for 50 mins

steps.title: Post-Experimental Storage and Cleanup
steps.instruction: Store samples and dispose of hazardous waste.

substeps.instruction: Store gDNA and PCR products at -20 °C
Dispose of EtBr waste (liquid and solid) in the proper container
